newsitem.title: UK: Oasis rock group wins MTV Europe music award.
newsitem.headline: Oasis rock group wins MTV Europe music award.

text.p: The rock group, Oasis, has been voted best group in the annual MTV Europe Music Awards, MTV said in a release on Friday.
The awards were broadcast late on Thursday from London's Alexandra Palace. More than half a million viewers of the music and youth entertainment network voted for their favourite artists.
Other winners included the singer George Michael who was voted best male artist and Alanis Morissette who picked up the best female artist award.
MTV said it had created a different award called the "Free Your Mind Award", which was meant to raise awareness of social issues.
MTV said that award went to the "buddies and carers of Europe", people who care for those with debilitating illnesses, especially those associated with HIV and AIDS.
MTV Europe is part of the MTV network which is owned by Viacom International Inc and broadcasts across 37 countries.
